fast.change: Added a call to cleanup_cache(cache_dir) after writing the cache file.
fast.impact: Introduces automated cache pruning or maintenance logic during every save operation.

detailed.change: The function now invokes a newly introduced side-effect function cleanup_cache after the serialization process is completed. This shifts the function from a pure write operation to one that actively manages the filesystem state of the cache directory. The logic assumes that external pruning is required whenever a new entry is successfully persisted.
detailed.impact: The execution time of save_cache is now dependent on the implementation of cleanup_cache. If the cleanup process is resource-intensive or slow, this will introduce latency into the calling code. It also potentially changes the filesystem footprint by removing older or expired files immediately upon saving new data.
detailed.risk: The risk is medium because introducing an external cleanup process inside a write function can cause unexpected performance degradation or race conditions if not thread-safe. If cleanup_cache behaves aggressively, it could accidentally delete relevant cache files during high-concurrency writes. medium
